results.evidence: The module delta is confined to the automation package, its tests and exact Platform V333; the shared inbox timestamp correction is separately owned by central backend dwp-dev commit 02c6901d53b7bd5c131189e76d3661ff0d13ee13.
AutomationController exposes exactly two GET and fourteen POST owner operations; carried SYS-002 IAQ, API and SYS-EVT-009 assets are reused without route, page-owner or recount changes.
Definition creation is identity and metadata only, and closed DTO tests reject unknown fields while version, schedule and activation commands retain separate normalized bodies.
Preserved PDX-004, PDX-005 and PDX-006 contract tests plus API and domain-policy tests pin closed fields, safe integers, scope values and retry modes.

V333 SHA-256 213a3cbde404b056b7d60b7791b59b0c8a0581248e7d775382f7092940d63c2d creates exactly eight automation tables, reuses five shared stores and installs tenant-composite FORCE RLS; clean install and real V332-to-V333 PostgreSQL upgrade passed.

Only signed compatible allowlisted TypedAutomationHandlerPort implementations execute; the canonical closed PDX decoder rejects arbitrary class, method and SQL fields and no production handler is bound.

Definition and version lifecycle tests cover validation, target-bound CAS, maker-checker approval, single ACTIVE retirement and current-manifest revalidation with fail-closed stale or mismatched evidence.

Schedules pin version, timezone and tzdb, input template reference and digest, concurrency template and policy digest; fire compares both persisted input facts and passes only persisted values to run creation. GOLD-050 proves same-digest/different-reference substitution is denied.
Command replay is caller, action, target and handler bound; server-derived concurrency and mutually exclusive WORKER, OWNER_RECOVERY and RECONCILER fence tuples are persisted and enforced.

NONE, FAILED_ITEMS_ONLY and WHOLE_INVOCATION retry modes use immutable selections, new attempts and monotonic checkpoints; the submitted processed digest must equal the current-attempt completed receipt subset.

Cancellation and compensation require separately fenced reconciler authority, persist PREPARED, COMMITTED or RESULT_UNKNOWN evidence and prevent owner-recovery dispatch or blind redispatch. Independent worker and reconciler fence namespaces are enforced by their authority trigger rather than an invalid numeric inequality.
Run CAS, shared receipt, closed SYS-EVT-004 outbox and audit facts commit or roll back atomically; terminal and checkpoint facts are immutable and canonical receipt-set digests are verified.
The frontend adds no route, sidebar, menu or page owner; visible actions are the intersection of lifecycle allowlist, persisted eligibility, caller authorization, visible facts and current manifest.

Frontend targeted reports passed model 8/8, client 11/11 and workbench 15/15, including loading, empty, complete, partial, unavailable, forbidden, retry and step-up states at 1440, 1280, 390 and 320 widths and 200 percent zoom.

The child remains unmounted, HRIS_AUTOMATION_CONTROL_PLANE remains default OFF, tenant enrollment is zero and production handler/provider/schedule counts remain zero; unmounted tests prove zero owner fetches.

goldenScenarios.evidence: AutomationGoldenAuthorizationEvidenceTest exercises owner filter to controller, service and JDBC with a non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS application role; tenant B sees an opaque NOT_FOUND and zero rows.
AutomationGoldenAuthorizationEvidenceTest permits disjoint maker/checker scopes and rejects effective-user overlap through real Auth SoD tables.
AutomationGoldenExecutionEvidenceTest performs signed typed execution and durable reload while canonical closed decoding rejects extra class, method and SQL fields.
Two execution tests prove same-payload idempotent replay and exact RESOURCE_CONFLICT HTTP 409 for a changed digest.
The real lease repository reloads after expiry with a higher fence and rejects stale renew, checkpoint and finalize operations.
The real worker invoke, finalize and checkpoint path retries only the FAILED_ITEMS_ONLY selection.
AutomationGoldenLifecycleEvidenceTest blocks terminal cancellation while an original side effect is unresolved and requires separately fenced reconciliation.

The production DomainEventInboxRepository on PostgreSQL deduplicates duplicate and out-of-order permission events and keeps revision 2 REVOKED after late revision 1. The PgJDBC timestamptz correction is central dwp-dev commit 02c6901d53b7bd5c131189e76d3661ff0d13ee13 and the exact method passed again after synchronization.
Purpose-only, scope-only, cross-tenant, revision and revoked-entitlement receipt lookups all fail closed with opaque 404 behavior.
Replay is subject-bound, changed payload conflicts and all nineteen sealed shared-receipt identity fields plus delete immutability are enforced.
The definition/version lifecycle accepts only signed, current, compatible and four-eyes-approved evidence.

The PostgreSQL lifecycle test covers pre-activation and suspended denial, exact CAS, pinned version/timezone/tzdb/concurrency, digest mismatch and same-digest/different-reference denial, then persists only the approved input reference and digest.
Three execution tests prove durable checkpoint resume, no repeat of successful effects, stale-fence/regression denial and current-attempt processed-digest equality.
Four execution tests prove the exact FAILED_ITEMS_ONLY frozen identity set and reject all-items substitution, empty selection and digest mismatch without creating another attempt.
Pre-effect cancellation and post-effect approved compensation are separated, audited and deduplicated; unproven or blind redispatch is rejected.
